provider_receipt.summary: Review found unsupported completion and security/privacy defects. The receipt verifies only a clean Git diff; it does not execute either cargo test command declared in docs/migration-notes.md:12-15, so functional completion is unproven. src/lib.rs:184-191 permits absolute and parent-directory wikilinks to escape the vault root and returns existing external paths, violating tenant isolation. src/lib.rs:107-125 scans every Markdown file and processes it without the classification, authority, privacy, or review gates required by docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:23-25 and 49-93. NoteFrontmatter at src/lib.rs:14-25 omits required contract metadata and models confidence as u8 although the contract requires low|medium|high, so contract-conforming notes cannot be ingested. MemoryStore::store at src/lib.rs:56-89 serializes each record and discards it, providing no durable Mnemosyne storage despite the stated persistent-memory interface. Existing tests cover neither vault-escape rejection nor ingestion-contract enforcement.
